Numbers 26:23 refers to the Punite clan descended from this Puah. Judges 10:1 identifies Tola the judge as 'son of Puah,' though this may be a different individual or refer to clan descent. The LXX transliterations vary (Phoua, Phouah, Puvah), reflecting Hebrew spelling variants. The name possibly relates to a root for plants or brightness, but its etymology remains uncertain."
